elements.content:
Lily: You seem a bit down. Did something happen?

Maria: I failed the English exam, so I feel sad.

Lily: It’s okay. Everyone fails sometimes. I can help

you with your English if you want.

Maria: Really? That would be great.

Lily: Of course, we’re friends. We can work together

to make progress. I’m sure you can do well next

time.

Maria: Thank you, Lily. I feel much better now.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

child_list.content:
莉莉：你看起来有点沮丧。发生什么事了

吗？

玛莉亚：我英语考试不及格，所以我很伤

心。

莉莉：没关系。每个人都有失败的时候。

如果你愿意，我可以帮助你学英

语。

玛莉亚：真的吗？那太好了。

莉莉：当然了，我们是朋友。我们可以共

同努力取得进步。我相信你下次能

做得很好。

玛莉亚：谢谢你，莉莉。我现在感觉好多

了。

child_list.content:

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
